title: llama-annotation-pipeline: Snakemake workflow and documented commands for homology-based and ab initio annotation of the Lama glama genome
description:
Reproducible Snakemake workflow for the structural annotation of a chromosome-level Lama glama genome assembly by homology transfer and ab initio prediction, with evaluation against an external reference.

The workflow generates four proteome sets and a combined candidate reference proteome of 20,708 sequences, stratified into three nested confidence layers: 18,920 high-confidence models with an intact reading frame and detectable homology in an external reference, 1,313 extended-reference models failing one or both criteria, and 475 candidates from the ab initio prediction.

The Snakemake workflow covers Liftoff, miniprot, proteome extraction and BUSCO. LiftOn, Helixer, InterProScan and DIAMOND were run manually, with the commands documented in REPRODUCIBILITY.md.

No sequence or annotation data are tracked in this repository. The annotation sets and proteomes are deposited separately under CC0-1.0, concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21445839.
